name: Command chip cycle
looks: A glowing rounded pill types in and then cycles through two or three short names, one per beat, with a quick scale-and-opacity swap on each change. The last name holds, larger and brighter, as the shot's payoff.
build: Build the pill as DOM with a box-shadow glow plus a blurred duplicate layer behind it. Type the first name on, cut the rest in on the beat, and ramp the final glow up from the clock as it lands.
sound: A blip per swap and a riser into the final brighten.
prompt: Show a glowing pill or chip that types in a short label, then cycles through two or three alternative words on the beat before settling, brighter and larger, on one final answer. Use it for any moment that lands on a single choice: a plan, a mode, a feature, a name.
